name: NoOp
mechanic: Does nothing to your trade - the blank template to build your own hook on.
plain: This hook does nothing to your trade. It lets every swap go through exactly as-is and only takes the standard protocol fee. It's the empty template: start here, then add your own rule to make it do something.
rules: Every swap passes through exactly as submitted.
No rule beyond the standard protocol fee applies.
The blank template - fork it and add your own logic.
